snippet.title: 001 Earth First Ever Dev Talk!
snippet.description:
Hey everyone, it's CGNDC! Today, we'll talk about the latest updates for 001 Earth and why it's not quite like the original plan. We'll show you how the game has evolved over time with some neat progress clips.

And a big shoutout to @Graeldon for their insightful video! While we didn't cover the whole thing here, if you want to catch the full scoop, check out their video at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=seu-yrXS_VE. Thanks for your awesome content, @Graeldon!

And a heartfelt thank you to all of you who've supported 001 Earth, even though we haven't implemented most of its features yet. Your feedbacks and encouragement means the world to us!
